description: This file defines a PHP trait named DecoratorTrait within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods for lazy-loading and retrieving a decorator object for an entity, along with generating decorator class names dynamically.

methods.name: getDecorator
methods.description: Returns the decorator object, initializing it if it has not been set yet.

methods.name: getDecoratorClassName
methods.description: Generates the fully qualified class name of the decorator based on the current class name.
